import requests
import json

# Set API endpoint and API key
endpoint = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-3-flash-preview:generateContent"
api_key = YOUR_API_KEY

# Set model and contents for the request
model = "gemini-3-flash-preview"  # model to use for generation
contents = "Write a story about a character who discovers a hidden world."  # text to generate content from

# Create a dictionary for the request body
body = {
    "model": model,  # model to use for generation
    "contents": contents  # text to generate content from
}

# Set headers with API key
headers = {
    "x-goog-api-key": api_key,  # API key for authentication
    "Content-Type": "application/json"  # specify JSON body
}

# Make the POST request
response = requests.post(endpoint, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(body))

# Check status code
if response.status_code == 200:
    print("Request successful")
    print(response.json())
else:
    print("Request failed with status code", response.status_code)
    print(response.text)
